title: Benchmark classical single-cell batch integration without erasing biology
description: Direct Codex to inspect a real quality-controlled h5ad and crossed biological design; generate project-specific Harmony, Scanorama, and BBKNN runs from the same batch-aware feature and PCA foundation; execute each method in the user's existing scientific environment; compare batch mixing against label-neighborhood purity, label graph connectivity, silhouettes, unknown-label retention, and raw-count preservation; reject overcorrection and label leakage; and admit only a method whose observed outputs pass declared scientific gates.
intents: benchmark Harmony Scanorama and BBKNN single-cell integration
single-cell batch correction with biological conservation
单细胞批次整合方法比较与生物结构保留
questions: Which validated classical integration method improves cross-batch neighborhood mixing while preserving independently reviewed biological structure, unknown cells, raw counts, and sample-level interpretability?
assumptions: Raw counts and cell identities are valid and immutable; batches are technical strata rather than the biological contrast itself; biological samples and batches are declared separately; reviewed evaluation labels contain an explicit unknown category and are used only after integration; and every known evaluation label needed for adjudication spans multiple batches.
preconditions: Codex can inspect the actual h5ad and sample manifest; raw-count, batch, biological-sample, and evaluation-label semantics are known; batch-by-sample-by-label cross-tabs permit an integration comparison; the existing scientific environment contains the declared compatible classical backends; and no environment or compute-infrastructure management is required.

quality_gates.description: Block when raw counts, cell or feature identities, batch, biological sample, evaluation label, unknown label, feature namespace, source digest, or sample nesting cannot be established without guessing.

Block comparative adjudication when batch is perfectly confounded with the target biology, known evaluation labels do not span batches, biological samples are duplicated across ambiguous batches, or the design lacks independent replication.

Evaluation labels, expected cell types, conditions, and desired conclusions must not enter Harmony, Scanorama, BBKNN, feature selection, PCA, or neighbor construction; they may be read only by post hoc conservation metrics.
An integration candidate must improve declared cross-batch neighborhood mixing over the unintegrated PCA baseline without relying on UMAP appearance alone.
Block candidates whose label-neighborhood purity loss, label graph fragmentation, label silhouette loss, unknown-cell loss, or sample composition indicates overcorrection or biological erasure.
Raw counts, cells, features, metadata, integrated representation or graph, embedding, method parameters, and quality state must survive output reload exactly as declared.
A selected method must remain eligible across justified HVG, PCA, neighbor, and random-seed sensitivity checks; no universal method is selected solely by one aggregate score.

version_differences.description: External integration wrappers, AnnData storage, neighbor graph keys, and UMAP behavior are tied to the tested Scanpy release and dependencies.
version_differences.required_action: Use only detected wrapper signatures and independently reload representations, graphs, embeddings, and raw counts.

version_differences.description: harmonypy 0.2.0 may expose Z_corr in cells-by-components orientation while older Scanpy wrappers transpose it under a components-by-cells assumption.
version_differences.required_action: Call the detected Harmony API, validate both possible orientations against the frozen PCA shape, normalize to cells by components, and compare corrected neighborhoods with the unchanged PCA baseline.

version_differences.description: Dataset matching, approximation, and integrated embedding behavior are version-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record exact versus approximate matching and independently evaluate integrated neighbors and conservation metrics.

version_differences.description: Per-batch neighbor selection, trimming, approximate search, and graph serialization are version-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record per-batch neighbors and search mode and evaluate the graph rather than treating baseline PCA as a corrected embedding.

limitations: The validated row covers classical h5ad integration with crossed batches and reviewed post hoc labels. It does not establish that integration is necessary, repair a confounded design, infer cell identities, replace donor-aware inference, or support scVI, scANVI, Seurat anchors, WNN, Azimuth, CellTypist, or popV. BBKNN yields a balanced graph rather than a corrected expression matrix. Harmony and Scanorama embeddings must not be used for count-level differential expression. Selection remains project-specific, and environment or compute-resource management is outside plugin scope.

concept_sources: Project-owned Codex-native integration benchmark synthesized from independently reviewed method contracts and biological-conservation principles.

template_sections.purpose: Establish whether integration is scientifically identifiable and necessary before invoking a correction method.
required_logic: Inspect raw counts, source reductions, sample and batch nesting, condition, known technical factors, reviewed labels, unknown labels, and feature namespace from the actual object.
Cross-tabulate biological samples, batches, conditions, and evaluation labels; block perfect confounding and labels confined to one batch.
Define the unintegrated PCA baseline and predeclare technical-mixing and biological-conservation metrics without inspecting method outcomes.

template_sections.purpose: Generate and execute method-specific integration branches from one frozen preprocessing foundation.
required_logic: Use the same immutable raw counts, normalization, batch-aware HVGs, scaled HVG matrix, PCA basis, random seed, and evaluation neighborhood size for every candidate unless a documented method constraint requires a sensitivity branch.
Run Harmony and Scanorama as embedding corrections and BBKNN as graph correction using their detected validated APIs.
Never expose evaluation labels, desired annotations, condition outcomes, or expected conclusions to candidate fitting.

template_sections.purpose: Quantify technical mixing and independent biological conservation against the unchanged baseline.
required_logic: Compute normalized batch-neighbor entropy, batch silhouette, known-label neighbor purity, label silhouette, and per-label graph connectivity using fixed post hoc labels and retain unknown cells.
Compare integrated values with baseline deltas and inspect sample composition; UMAP appearance is descriptive only.
Block overcorrection, label fragmentation, unknown-cell loss, raw-count mutation, or improvement driven by a confounded design.

template_sections.purpose: Select an eligible representation only after method and parameter sensitivity review.
required_logic: Repeat eligible candidates across justified HVG, PCA, neighbor, and seed perturbations and preserve all candidate reports.
Choose no method when integration is unnecessary or every candidate fails; do not force a winner.
Declare whether downstream tasks may use the selected embedding or graph and preserve raw counts for count-level inference.

template_sections.purpose: Reload every candidate object and bind the selected decision to observed artifacts and quality gates.
required_logic: Reload cells, features, raw counts, integrated representation or graph, UMAP, method metadata, and benchmark reports.
Verify template, input, output, sample-manifest, tool-version, dependency-version, parameter, and quality-gate provenance.
Admit only the selected observed artifact; preserve blocked candidates and reasons as non-evidentiary execution history.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Run integration only when a declared technical factor materially distorts the representation used by the downstream task and the design permits correction.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Retain the unintegrated baseline and allow no-integration as a valid selected decision.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Freeze a batch-aware HVG and PCA foundation from log-normalized counts and test neighboring choices without using labels.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require finite components, adequate HVGs, raw-count separation, and comparable candidate inputs.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare one evaluation neighborhood size and use it for baseline and candidate metrics; separately record BBKNN per-batch neighbor construction.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Repeat conclusions over a defensible neighboring range and block candidates whose ranking is unstable.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Require a predeclared improvement over baseline rather than an absolute visual target.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Interpret mixing only alongside sample composition, confounding review, and biological-conservation gates.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare maximum purity loss and minimum connectivity from label reliability and biological granularity before candidate comparison.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Block any candidate that erases, fragments, or forcibly absorbs reviewed or unknown populations even when technical mixing improves.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Select among eligible methods by the downstream representation needed and conservation robustness, not by one aggregate score.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require explicit no-selection when no candidate remains eligible and prohibit corrected embeddings as count matrices.

preflight_checks: Inspect the actual h5ad and establish raw-count, batch, biological-sample, evaluation-label, unknown-label, feature, and annotation semantics.
Detect Scanpy, harmonypy, Scanorama, BBKNN, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, UMAP, Numba, and neighbor-search versions in the existing scientific environment.
Verify every biological sample maps to one batch and every known evaluation label spans at least two batches; identify batch-condition and batch-label confounding.
Freeze common preprocessing, candidate methods, metric definitions, quality thresholds, sensitivity grid, random seeds, and new output paths before execution.
Confirm labels are inaccessible to integration fitting and that source objects will not be modified.
postflight_checks: Reconcile cell, feature, metadata, unknown-label, and raw-count identities before and after every candidate.
Reload each integrated h5ad and verify representation or graph semantics, UMAP presence, parameters, versions, and quality status.
Recompute baseline and candidate batch entropy, label purity, label connectivity, and silhouettes independently using the fixed evaluation labels.
Compare candidate sensitivity across HVGs, PCs, neighbors, and seeds; inspect sample composition and retain all blocked methods and reasons.
Create a selected-method-or-none decision with an explicit downstream-use contract and update evidence only for observed eligible artifacts.
forbidden_actions: Do not install, update, activate, create, or manage Python, R, Conda, container, CPU, GPU, Slurm, remote, or local-model infrastructure.
Do not integrate a perfectly confounded design or treat integration as a repair for missing biological replication.
Do not use evaluation labels, desired annotations, conditions, expected markers, or desired conclusions during fitting or parameter tuning.
Do not select a method from UMAP appearance, batch mixing alone, or one aggregate score.
Do not overwrite raw counts, source objects, cell identities, unknown labels, or sample provenance.
Do not use corrected embeddings or graphs as count matrices for differential expression.
Do not report generated code, an unreloaded h5ad, or an ineligible candidate as validated integration evidence.
